_about: Survival tests next to the Cox engine (R/survival_tests.R). The design picks what runs; Biodes may set analysis.survival = {landmarks: [times], rmst_tau: time, logrank_weight: name, aft: true | [distributions], life_table: interval width, strata: [factors]}. Checks (proportional hazards) are reported, never used to switch the primary test.
_note_conf_type: survfit confidence intervals for survival and the median (survival package default; the median CI is the Brookmeyer-Crowley interval on this scale).
_note_rmst_tau: default horizon: the smallest of the groups' largest follow-up times, so tau is inside every group's support (Tian et al. 2020). analysis.survival.rmst_tau overrides; the report says which.
_note_strata: analysis.survival.strata columns stratify the log-rank and the Cox baseline (strata(v)); no coefficient is fitted for them (Biodes 01d41ef).
_note_stratify_by_blocks: a design with blocks (RCBD reps, randomization strata) gets a stratified log-rank (strata(block)) as the primary test, the analysis matching the randomization; the unstratified test is reported next to it.
_note_logrank_weight: names (survMisc::comp rows): logrank (FH 0,0), gehan (Gehan-Breslow), tarone_ware, peto (Peto-Peto, = survdiff rho 1), fh_1_0 (early), fh_0_1 (late), fh_1_1 (middle). Only the prespecified weight is the primary test; scanning weights for the smallest p is not done.
_note_aft: analysis.survival.aft = true fits every distribution and reports the time ratios of the lowest AIC (differences < 2 noted as indistinguishable); a list fits those. Weibull time ratios convert to hazard ratios: HR = TR^(-shape).
_note_min_events_per_term: Cox model with fewer events per coefficient than this is flagged (overfitting; Peduzzi et al. 1995).
_note_cox_block_terms: fixed block terms (role block) in a Cox model: >= frailty_min_blocks blocks -> a shared frailty (1 | block) (the engine chain: coxme, else a gamma frailty); fewer -> strata(block). As fixed coefficients small blocks diverge and bias the HR toward 0 (Simitall check, 30 blocks of 2, true HR 0.7, 20 runs: fixed 0.50, strata 0.67, frailty 0.68, none 0.69; SD of log HR 0.57, 0.36, 0.32, 0.31). Same cut as Biodes' cluster rule.
_note_nonph: goal truth with proportional_hazards false (Simitall delayed_effect / early_effect / crossing): detection by the prespecified weighted log-rank (analysis.survival.logrank_weight or goal_effect.survival.test), estimate by a piecewise Cox fit split at outcome_model.change_time (HR per phase); the affected phase's HR is compared with the true HR.
